summary: Implemented minimalist Dark Neumorphism UI, 5 multiplayer games, and verified CYHI hackathon Track 2 compliance.
Implemented InkCognito-inspired single-page no-scroll landing, Light+Dark mode toggle, Emoji Pop Reflex arcade game, vector doodle aesthetics, and bouncy playful audio.
Refined color system to minimal studio palette, added micro-dot studio background pattern, streamlined navigation and removed redundant buttons.
Resolved landing page initial load glitches: added instant theme initialization script in index.html, fixed fluid grid dimensions, and guarded user profile state.
Fixed floating doodles vertical stacking and layout displacement by adding fixed overlay positioning and clean viewport centering in Landing.css.
Authenticated with InsForge CLI and linked project TheBackrooms (2ff18a3a-4ffb-44b1-993b-fa7b13b1c4b6), installed agent skills, and verified backend context.
Deployed full application to InsForge / Vercel edge production at https://ycrxi75f.insforge.site and verified live bundle.
Resolved hosted room creation and live multi-user interaction by implementing universal PeerJS WebRTC Mesh + BroadcastChannel RealtimeMesh engine, and redeployed to https://ycrxi75f.insforge.site.

Rebranded to TheBackrooms, recreated reference front page with avatar orbit and alias wells, implemented Room Code joining system, fixed active presence ping, converted mini-games to interactive animated pop-up modal, animated dissolving messages, removed panic button/arena clutter, and deployed to https://ycrxi75f.insforge.site.
Committed full codebase with clean .gitignore and comprehensive README.md, ready for GitHub remote push.
Configured origin remote to https://github.com/AnmolBhardwaj0-0/The-Backrooms.git and rebased commits ready for push.
Formulated implementation plan for Squarespace fluid animations, refined eye-pleasing dark/light contrast, and in-window game arena alongside chat
Implemented Squarespace fluid animations, refined dark/light mode contrast, converted all mini-games to in-window arena alongside chat, and deployed to InsForge and GitHub

Enhanced animations across TheBackrooms: direction-aware page transitions in App.jsx, spring click/hover feedback on all buttons, staggered scroll reveals via Reveal.jsx, AnimatePresence modal exits in Lobby.jsx, and fluid game stage crossfades and animated chat bubbles in RoomView.jsx.

Pulled git changes, implemented Blood Void (Dark) and Cream Noir (Light) theme system, integrated 3-tier typography system (Space Grotesk, Sora, JetBrains Mono), and identified the root cause of the name input auto-refill bug.
Deployed Blood Void / Cream Noir dual theme system, 3-tier typography system (Space Grotesk, Sora, JetBrains Mono), and patched name input auto-refill bug to InsForge and pushed to GitHub main.
Added production static-file serving and SPA wildcard route from client/dist to server/server.js for single-service deployment without modifying any socket logic or client files.

Deployed frontend to InsForge site (Deployment ID: 7789e664-ee2d-4e31-bed3-7008622c48ec), committed and pushed static-serving backend to GitHub origin main, restarted local Node backend server, and verified both /api/health and / static serving return 200 OK.
Investigated InsForge backend deployment: confirmed InsForge standard platform cannot host persistent Socket.io, inspected frontend socket init and CORS.
Wired frontend to live Render backend URL, updated backend CORS and health route, pushed changes to GitHub, and redeployed frontend to InsForge.
Pushed all repository commits, backend CORS updates, environment configurations, and cyhi logs to GitHub origin main.

UI/UX polish pass complete: added playDissolve()+playJoinChime() to sound.js; ember-glow burn bar + refined vaporize easing + contrast tokens + presence glow vars + bounce transition token in index.css; one-shot session tagline badge in Landing.jsx/css; SVG room-type icons + activity-level CSS-var glow on Lobby.jsx/css room cards; toolbar auto-hide (RAF idle timer), canvas stroke fade loop, dissolve chime trigger, join chime swap, avatar --activity-level var in RoomView.jsx; toolbar-hidden class + presence avatar glow + contrast + tab-pill shadow in Room.css. Build: vite exit 0, 473 modules, 0 errors.

Completed editorial minimalism UI pass: global tokens, Landing redesign with serif/italic hero typography and clean solid buttons, Lobby modal overflow fix with internal scroll wrapper and responsive grid, flat room cards, and active tab states across Landing, Lobby, and Room. Verified with clean production build and pushed to GitHub main.

Pulled latest repository changes from GitHub origin main, resolved node_modules EPERM lock and updated client and server dependencies, built production client bundle via vite, added /health and /api/health endpoints and client/dist static serving to server/server.js, pushed fixes to GitHub main to trigger Render deployment, and verified both localhost:3001 and localhost:5173 return HTTP 200 OK.

Deployed updated frontend to InsForge (Deployment ID: dab0c688-8454-4dba-b0bb-e69e4ee3f514) via @insforge/cli deployments deploy client. Verified map.geojson returns 200 OK on https://ycrxi75f.insforge.site/map.geojson, and verified Render backend is live with /health and /api/health responding.

Clean git pull performed with 0 code modifications. Rebuilt client production bundle via vite, redeployed frontend to InsForge (Deployment ID: 5a7a5931-4e7f-48fe-8f17-f4fb8129ddc2), verified Render production backend health, verified localhost servers, and validated tile provider and map.geojson responses.

Fixed canvas stroke socket emit payload in RoomView.jsx from { roomId, stroke } to flat stroke object, verified real-time stroke sync and late-join canvas history replay across 3 clients, deployed frontend to InsForge (Deployment ID: 3d653f0b-a17c-4351-b664-194d7b16d182), and pushed to GitHub main to trigger Render backend deployment.

Formulated comprehensive implementation plan for location-based room visibility (100m Haversine radius), InsForge persistence for Lost & Found and Trade messages, and inactivity-based room lifetime with activity heartbeats and visual countdown.

Implemented Location-Based Room Visibility (100m radius), InsForge persistence for Lost & Found and Trade Messages, and Inactivity-Based Room Lifetime with visual countdown progress bar and activity heartbeats. Fully tested and verified.

Fixed join-by-lounge-code: enhanced server join_room_by_code matching (case-insensitive, #-prefix strip, ID fallback), added error feedback in App/Landing/Lobby. Fixed 100m room visibility: rooms now show if within 100m OR live (active users/permanent hubs). Added isPermanent to formatRoomForLobby and room_joined_data. Added low-accuracy GPS fallback in geo.js. All 7 automated tests pass.
